name: The Els Club Vilamoura
golf_list: The Els Club Vilamoura (former Victoria course)
source_titles: The Els Club Vilamoura|Ernie Els Design|Arrow Global|Details (IAGTO release)
notes: Photo: a still from the club's own film (elsclubvilamoura.com, Untitled-design-10-2.mp4, 8 s). Owner: 'Redesigned from the famed Victoria Course, our 18-hole championship course'. Opened for play 21 Jul 2025 (Ernie Els Design). OSM outline r1506063 is still named 'Dom Pedro Victoria Golf Course'. Point: OSM building w260309511 'Oceanico Victoria Golf Reception / Club House' (pre-redesign name; current clubhouse position not confirmed by owner). Club address 'Caminho da Fonte do Ulme' runs along the outline's east edge (14 m). Film: https://www.elsclubvilamoura.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Untitled-design-10-2.mp4 (© The Els Club Vilamoura)

name: Old Course Vilamoura
notes: Opened 1969 (owner). Point: clubhouse, OSM way w261149981 'Oceanico Old Course Golf Reception / Club House'; first tee (start of OSM hole 1, w261313246, par 4 as on owner's card): 37.10149,-8.11534. Owner calls hole 4 (par 3 over the pond) 'the most scenic hole'. Photo: https://www.vilamouragolf.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/oldcourse-background-2-scaled.jpg (© Vilamoura Golf)

name: Pinhal
architect: Frank Pennink, Robert Trent Jones Sr.
notes: Opened 1976 (vilamouraworld). Point: first tee = start of OSM hole 1 (w261419437, par 5 as on owner's card: 498 m). No clubhouse mapped in OSM. Photo (drone): https://www.vilamouragolf.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Pinhal-DJI_0520.jpg (© Vilamoura Golf)

name: Laguna
notes: Architect from vilamouraworld.com (owner). Point: first tee = start of OSM hole 1 (w261139180, par 5 as on owner's card). Clubhouse shared with Millennium: OSM w92444797 'Oceanico Millenium/Laguna Golf Reception / Club House' 37.10076,-8.13524. Photo (drone): https://www.vilamouragolf.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Laguna-DJI_0115-HDR.jpg (© Vilamoura Golf)

name: Millennium
notes: Opened 2000: nine new holes plus the refurbished inward half of the original 27-hole Laguna (vilamouraworld). Architect not named on owner pages (courses.csv has Martin Hawtree from VisitPortugal: unconfirmed by owner). Point: first tee = start of OSM hole 1 (w261116299, par 4 as on owner's card); clubhouse shared with Laguna (37.10076,-8.13524). Photo (drone): https://www.vilamouragolf.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Millennium-DJI_0170.jpg (© Vilamoura Golf)

name: Palmares (Alvor, Lagos and Praia nines)
source_titles: Palmares Ocean Living & Golf|Details (IAGTO release)|Details (IAGTO release)
notes: 27 holes in three nines: Alvor 1-9, Lagos 10-18, Praia 19-27 (owner). Counted as ONE course in Details' '12'. Originally established in the 1970s; full redesign by RTJ Jr. Point: OSM w330050098 'Onyria Palmares Golf Reception'. Photo: https://www.palmaresliving.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/palmares-golf-course-lagos-min.jpg (© Palmares Ocean Living & Golf)

name: Monte Rei North Course
notes: Owner: 'since 2007', 7,182 yards, par 72 (courses.csv has 2006 from VisitPortugal). Details release: closed April to September 2026 for renovation. Point: first tee = start of OSM hole 1 (w1420748672, par 4); clubhouse not mapped in OSM. Owner's course map describes the 13th 'towards the stunning backdrop of a natural lake'. Image: https://www.monte-rei.com/media/1744/hole_13.jpg (© Monte Rei Golf & Country Club; not opened, may be a hole drawing)

name: San Lorenzo
source_titles: San Lorenzo Golf Course|Details (IAGTO release)|The Golf Wire
notes: NOT SHOWN: listed in Details releases, but the course site is still JJW-branded and names no architect; management to confirm. Listed in Details' portfolio (releases Feb-Mar 2026); The Golf Wire (26 Feb 2026): 'opened in 1988 and designed by Joseph Lee and Rocky Roquemore'. The course's own site names no architect and carries JJW branding: ownership/management to confirm. Point: OSM w93266741 'San Lorenzo Golf Clubhouse' (inside outline). Photo: https://www.sanlorenzogolfcourse.com/media/244134/san-lorenzo-golf-banner-hole-6-view.jpg (credit unclear: JJW site)

name: Troia Golf
notes: Grândola (Tróia peninsula), not Algarve. Opened 1980, par 72 (owner). Owner: under a 12-month renovation, reopening planned for early 2027. Point: OSM w156397390 golf=clubhouse. Photo: https://www.troiaresort.pt/wp-content/uploads/Troia_Golf-1.jpg (© Troia Resort)
